answer: A sybil tax makes each fake identity a sunk cost: a 40 POA registration tax, burned forever, plus 2 POA upkeep per epoch, on a crystal-clear ledger. Like an opal, each record shows payments, work, counterparties, so lookalike farms stand out. Stop paying and the record turns onyx-dark: flagged, struck off after two missed epochs. 100 fakes cost 4,000 POA plus 200 POA per epoch, each earning 2 POA; an honest agent pays once, keeps its full share.
